$comment: Named, versioned machine-verification suite for cinatra-ai/blog-wordpress-publish-agent — the gate-arm half of the truthful verification-record model (the Truthful Attribution protocol §4). The truthful-attribution-gate reads THIS file at the merged SHA (authoritative, no TOCTOU) when a merge record carries a Gate-suite arm: the cited suiteId@version must equal this file's, the Accountable trailer must equal accountable{github,name,email}, and every requiredContexts entry must have concluded success on the reviewed head. The four pinned entries are exactly the contexts this repository's main ruleset requires, each naming the reusable workflow it calls and the sha this repository's OWN caller pins — read from .github/workflows/, never carried over from another repository. The truthful-attribution-gate entry is named BY CONTEXT only: its engine pin lives in the caller's uses: line (.github/workflows/truthful-attribution-gate.yml, itself a high-risk path), so this file carries no second copy of it to drift. highRiskPaths EXTENDS the central cinatra-ai/ci defaults (the gate verifies the effective set is a superset); this repository ships no release or publish script of its own — its release workflow lives under .github/**, which is already listed. High-risk changes (this file is itself one — see **/gate-suite.json) require the HUMAN arm at tier=maintainer; the gate arm alone is rejected, so this file's birth carries a maintainer Reviewed-by, not a self-blessing gate arm. lastAuditedAt + auditEvidence are the §4 monthly-audit record; the Accountable engineer re-audits monthly and bumps BOTH coupled in one commit (the gate warns >35d, fails the gate arm >65d; the human arm is always still available).
auditEvidence: 2026-09-15, the birth of this suite on its own pull request (engineering#670, under engineering#669): every context listed here is read on that pull request's head — the four the repository's main ruleset requires plus the truthful-attribution-gate — and must conclude green there, and each pinned sha was read from this repository's own caller workflow under .github/workflows/ at head 283f929a8f746614137159123800ef3c64295ac5, never copied from another repository's suite.
